data.name: Liminal Descenders
data.detailed_description:
Dive into Liminal Descenders, an intense pixel art "survivor-roguelike" shooter packed with action (roguelike), set within the dark and paranormal Backrooms. Explore the most iconic Backrooms environments while facing relentless waves of fierce enemies. Survive long enough to reach the final boss. As you progress, you'll level up and spend your points on upgrades and survivor-style abilities. With four main abilities and one ultimate skill, you'll be able to create incredible combos and eliminate enemies in powerful and deeply satisfying ways. Alongside the upgrades and weapons you discover throughout each area, fight your way forward and escape the Backrooms.

FEATURES

In Liminal Descenders, we offer you an epic experience where you will survive in the Backrooms, facing waves of enemies, upgrading your abilities, and exploring a pixel art liminal world—both inviting and terrifying. Join us in this adventure, where every run is unique. Currently, we offer the following:

  • Smooth and responsive controls, very comfortable.

  • Upgrades as you level up, making each run different.

  • Fun and action-packed gameplay.

  • Epic and satisfying abilities to take down waves of enemies.

  • A variety of unique enemies, inspired by the Backrooms.

  • A beautiful semi-realistic pixel art environment, with attractive colors and a liminal, cozy, and terrifying atmosphere.

  • Unique and creative abilities for the protagonist, designed for fun and ingenuity, perfectly crafted, and combinable.

  • Defeat waves of enemies and the zone boss, unique and deeply inspired by the Backrooms.

  • Descend into the liminal space, an exquisite environment that blends survival with pixel art.

  • Have fun exploring this world that separates reality from the liminal, in this incredible action game.

data.short_description: Dive into Liminal Descenders, an intense top-down pixel art roguelike "survivor style" action game set within the mysterious Backrooms. Your mission is to survive a limited amount of time in each zone while facing relentless waves of enemies and upgrade your habilities.
